tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search RentReboot public NYC renter guides by keyword and return canonical URLs.

tools.name: list_alerted_listings
tools.description: List apartments RentReboot already sent to the connected renter, newest first, with saved, hidden, and contacted/toured/applied state. Pass nextCursor to see older alerts (up to the latest 200). Hidden apartments are left out unless includeHidden is true. Links open the listing through RentReboot. N

tools.name: update_alerted_listing
tools.description: Change the connected renter's state for one apartment from their alerts: save it, hide it, or mark it contacted, toured, or applied (status "none" clears it). Same as the buttons on the RentReboot dashboard. Use a listingId from list_alerted_listings.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the connected renter's plan (free or paid), whether apartment alerts are on or paused, market, alert frequency, and delivery channel, plus a link to manage the account.

tools.name: get_search_preferences
tools.description: Show the connected renter's saved alert search: budget, bedrooms, bathrooms, neighborhoods, move-in date, no-fee and rent-stabilized filters, amenities, subway lines, alert frequency, and channel. Read this before changing the search.

tools.name: find_search_neighborhoods
tools.description: Look up neighborhood names and ids the connected renter can add to their alert search, in their own market. Returns names only, not listings.

tools.name: update_search_preferences
tools.description: Change the connected renter's saved alert search. Send only the fields to change; everything else stays. Saves exactly like the RentReboot preferences page, so its rules apply (for example a search always keeps at least one neighborhood). For a new account, set city together with neighborhoods once;

tools.name: set_apartment_alerts
tools.description: Pause (enabled=false) or resume (enabled=true) the connected renter's apartment alerts. Their search, plan, billing, and Housing Connect settings stay as they are. Confirm with the renter first.

tools.name: list_upcoming_matches
tools.description: List historical apartment records matching the connected renter’s saved requirements, useful for planning upcoming availability. Read-only and excludes broker contact details and account identifiers.

tools.name: list_housing_lottery_applications
tools.description: List the connected renter’s provider-confirmed NYC Housing Connect application statuses. Read-only. Excludes credentials, application numbers, income, household details, email, and internal identifiers.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Retrieve a public RentReboot guide as Markdown using its slug.

tools.name: list_neighborhoods
tools.description: List NYC neighborhoods that have published RentReboot asking-rent percentile data.

tools.name: get_rent_data
tools.description: Retrieve aggregate asking-rent percentiles and sample sizes for a published NYC neighborhood. Values are not individual listings or personal data.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_housing_lottery_applications" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the connected renter’s provider-confirmed NYC Housing Connect application statuses. Read-only. Excludes credentials, application numbers, income, household…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, list_housing_lottery_applications · Private data: list_alerted_listings, list_upcoming_matches, list_housing_lottery_applications · Public sink: update_search_preferences, list_housing_lottery_applications.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, list_housing_lottery_applications · Private data: list_alerted_listings, list_upcoming_matches, list_housing_lottery_applications · Public sink: update_search_preferences, list_housing_lottery_applications

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
